content: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

The Role: We need a technical leader with a developer/DevSecOps background who is motivated to lead a team driving a high-velocity sales engine. This is a player/coach role whose time is shared running opportunities in front of customers alongside developing, hiring, and raising the bar for a team of Solutions Engineers doing that same work. You carry the team's number, not a personal one, and you earn credibility with your team by still doing the job yourself.

...liable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description As Sonar’s Marketing AI Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the AI agents and automated workflows that multiply the impact of the marketing function. You spend time with marketing stakeholders to understand their work in depth, identify where automation creates real leverage, and then build and iterate until it works well. You produce clear reporting on efficiency and impact, keeping marketing leadership informed on what the automations are actually delivering. The best person for this role might be a marketing ops veteran who has taught themselves to build with AI, or an automation engineer who has gone deep on how marketing actually works. Either way, what matters is the combination: you understand marketing processes from the inside, and you can build reliable automations that make those processes faster, smarter, and more scalable.

Position description Sonar’s marketing technology stack is a strategic asset — and this role owns it. As Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager, you are the business owner for our full suite of marketing platforms, including Google Analytics, Semrush, Profound, Qualified, and others. You define what we need from our tools, ensure they are configured and integrated correctly, and drive the adoption that turns investment into impact. This is a role for someone equally comfortable in a business requirements conversation and inside a tool’s admin console. You will work closely with marketing leaders, demand generation, content, web, and RevOps teams to keep our stack aligned to Sonar’s go-to-market motion — and ensure the people using it get real value from it every day.

The impact you will have The Sonar Solutions Engineering team is dedicated to helping our prospective customers achieve technical success with our products. This is your chance to join a growing team as we scale up our efforts to have maximum impact on our targeted customer base. As a Partner Solutions Engineer at Sonar, you’ll collaborate closely with partners to ensure they can effectively promote and integrate Sonar solutions. The Solutions Engineering team works as part of the Sales process and also engages with Marketing, Product Management, and Development teams to provide feedback on our products' ability to address the needs of our partner network.
